about.text: A semi-soft Armenian cheese made from pasteurized cow's milk. Similar to halloumi, its curds are boiled during production and the cheese is preserved in brine.

sources.text: curd heated twice (halloumi-like), pasteurised cow milk, sold in brine; firmer than chanakh; brining time not found
